requirements.text: The web application should allow users to transfer text from a textarea to a content display area through a button click. Specifically, when a user inputs text into the textarea with data-testid 'text-area' and clicks the button with data-testid 'move-text-button', the text should be moved to the content display area with data-testid 'content-display'. The textarea should then be cleared. The system should handle various scenarios: 1) If the textarea is empty when the button is clicked, an alert with the message '请输入文本信息' should be displayed, and no changes should occur in the content display area or textarea. 2) The system should support text input up to a maximum length of 280 characters, including special characters. 3) A progress indicator with data-testid 'progress-indicator' should update to reflect the number of characters moved relative to the total characters initially entered. Additionally, a progress bar with data-testid 'progress-bar' should visually indicate the text movement process, with each list item (data-testid 'progress-bar-item-1' to 'progress-bar-item-6') changing color sequentially during the transfer. The button should change its background color to '#ccc' during the text transfer process and revert once complete.

The web application should allow users to move text from a textarea (data-testid='text-area', id='text') to a content display area (data-testid='content-display', id='content') by clicking a button (data-testid='move-text-button', id='button'). Upon clicking the button, if the textarea is empty, an alert with the message '请输入文本信息' should be displayed, and no further action should occur. If the textarea contains text, the button's background should change to '#ccc', and a progress bar (data-testid='progress-bar') should become visible. The text should be moved character by character from the textarea to the content display area, updating the progress indicator (data-testid='progress-indicator', strong element) to show the format 'X/Y', where X is the number of characters moved and Y is the total number of characters initially present in the textarea. The progress bar should visually indicate progress by changing the background color of its items (data-testid='progress-bar-item-1' to 'progress-bar-item-6') as the text is moved. The system should handle text up to a maximum length of 280 characters, and the progress indicator should accurately reflect the movement of special characters as well.

When the button with data-testid 'move-text-button' is clicked, the system should change the button's background color to '#ccc' to indicate activation, provided that the textarea with data-testid 'text-area' is not empty. If the textarea is empty, the button's background color should remain unchanged, and an alert should be displayed with the message '请输入文本信息'.

The system must clear the content display area with data-testid 'content-display' each time the button with data-testid 'move-text-button' is clicked. If the text area with data-testid 'text-area' contains text, the content display area should initially be empty before displaying the text. If the text area is empty, an alert with the message '请输入文本信息' should be shown, and the content display area should remain empty.

generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the move-text-button when the textarea contains valid text (within 280 characters, including special characters) successfully moves the text to the content-display area, clears the textarea, updates the progress indicator and progress bar items sequentially, and temporarily changes the button background to #ccc.

generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the move-text-button when the textarea is empty displays an alert with the message '请输入文本信息', leaves the content-display area empty, does not clear the textarea, and does not change the button background color.

generated_cases.title: Transfer maximum length text
generated_cases.description: Verify that the system successfully supports and transfers text input up to the maximum length boundary of 280 characters, accurately updating the progress indicator and progress bar elements.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Move text from textarea to content display
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Text Movement from Textarea to Content Display
  The system should allow users to move text from the textarea to the content display area by clicking a button.


  Scenario: [Normal] Move text from textarea to content display
    Given the webpage is loaded
    And the textarea with data-testid "text-area" is visible
    And the content display area with data-testid "content-display" is empty
    When the user enters "Hello World" into the textarea with data-testid "text-area"
    And the user clicks the button with data-testid "move-text-button"
    Then the content display area with data-testid "content-display" should contain "Hello World"
    And the textarea with data-testid "text-area" should be empty

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Used to partition input text conditions into empty and non-empty classes for the textarea.
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Used to test the stated maximum length limit of 280 characters for text input.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Used to cover the sequential progress states of the progress bar items and button background color changes during transfer.
technique_rationales.decision_table: Used to cover combinations of conditions such as textarea state (empty vs non-empty) and the resulting actions (alert vs text transfer).
technique_rationales.use_case: Used to cover the end-to-end user workflow of entering text, clicking the button, observing progress indicators, and clearing the textarea.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Used to explore plausible failure conditions such as clicking the transfer button when the textarea is empty.
